Subject: Micro-SIG spot-check call + log upload runbook

Hi Maya / Xavier —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the SIG intake. To keep the questionnaire sprint moving, we'd like to run a short 30-minute spot-check focused on log samples and key controls (authz, key management, and ingress/egress logging). Goal: confirm evidence format, sampling windows, and a simple upload path so your team can drop artifacts securely.

Proposed times (PST):
- Tue Oct 6, 10:00–10:30
- Tue Oct 6, 14:30–15:00
- Wed Oct 7, 09:00–09:30

Agenda (30m):
1) Quick intro + scope (5m)
2) Logs & artifacts we need (10m) — examples below
3) Walk through secure upload/runbook (10m)
4) Next steps & owners (5m)

Quick list of suggested evidence to have ready for the call:
- Audit/auth logs (1–2 days sample)
- API ingress logs (sample requests + response codes)
- KMS usage/logs for key rotation (last 90 days summary)
- Tenant isolation diagram (PDF)
- Any redaction/PII masking notes you follow

We can also accept masked or redacted samples — please mark what was redacted. If these are large, we'll provide an SFTP/secure upload link.

If one of those times works, I'll send a calendar invite and attach a short runbook for the upload flow.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Enterprise Security Partner, Redwood Inference

Attachment: none in this message (runbook to follow)
